presets.title: Guidance, not enforcement
presets.notes: Two nys-cards. The card is the system's: same border, radius, and heading on both. What you slot into it is yours. The left stat block uses tokens; the right one is hard-coded to the same values, so they look identical today. Nothing in the system stops the second one. Uncomment the :root block to release a system change and watch only the left one follow. The next slide shows the same problem with a real agency theme.

presets.title: Switch the agency theme
presets.notes: Same card, built twice. The left one takes its colors from theme tokens. The right one uses the same colors as hex values, copied from the default theme. Today they match. Select Agency theme, then Administration. To skip the list, tab to Agency theme and press A. Point at the header first: the whole page took the new theme. Then the left card: the banner and Renew now followed. Then the right card: the banner and Renew now are still NY.gov blue, next to a Check status button that turned rust. Two brands in one card, and no release can fix it. Someone has to find every copied hex value, in every app that copied it. Try Health too, then select Default (NY.gov) to show they matched all along.
